label: Primitive — Grid
description: Composable gridline overlay primitive (horizontal/vertical/both) — thin fixed-px strips at proportional offsets; nests cleanly at any canvas.

show.label: Show grid
show.description: Whether the grid renders. Default true.

count.label: Intervals
count.description: Number of equal intervals across the axis. Default 5.

origin.label: Origin
origin.description: Origin for fractions: "top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right". Default depends on direction.

excludeEdges.label: Hide outer lines
excludeEdges.description: If true, do not render the outer boundary lines. Default true.
